notes.title: Content Update: Two New Levels
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28597375/962f99d4c9d5180651cd88ce0c0aea3567718680.png[/img]

[h1][b]What's up, partygoers![/b][/h1]

Today, we bring you a big content update featuring not one but [b]TWO[/b] new levels. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28597375/ae6fd0b0d36c0938b4975f5cfdb65dafa070f25a.gif[/img][h2][b]🐸 New Level: Delirium Heights[/b][/h2]

Another free bonus level hits the scene! This level is rich with hidden environmental story details that reveal the deep lore of our beloved character, Frogger, and his homeland. Prepare for a trippy experience, uncovering secrets hidden within the game's most mysterious setting yet.

[i]Unlocks after completing the main story.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28597375/3a9d29218f1078ba802e3696aadbc3c8631a6ec7.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28597375/354cfd2960fa470581a70a12a0175fc483d50393.gif[/img][h2][b]🚀 New Level: Moon[/b][/h2]

Set foot on an unparalleled lunar adventure. Navigate through innovative traps and interact with new objects that challenge your tactical skills. [b]Moon[/b] introduces a host of novel objectives, pushing the limits of what you thought was possible in [i][b]Party Hard 2[/b][/i].

[i]Unlocks after completing the main story and the [b]Delirium Heights[/b] level.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]What Else's New:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New objects and traps
[/list]
[h3][b]Enhancements & Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Default brightness and post-process options fixed.
[*] A bug with Marena at the Punch Club level ending fixed.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
By the way, [i][b]Party Hard 2[/b][/i] is [b]80% off[/b] until April 24th! Pick it up now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/572430/Party_Hard_2/

Remember that you can gift the game to a friend and play together if you already own it.


[b]Party harder, everybody![/b]

[b][url=https://www.instagram.com/party.hard.2/]INSTAGRAM[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/partyhardgames]FACEBOOK[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/partyhardgame]TWITTER[/url] (X)
[url=http://discord.gg/partyhard]DISCORD[/url][/b]

notes.title: Comic Book Sequel "Party Hard: Breakout" Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28597375/75a8862f9c0fb13681e1d950d28cc686d3ef34fa.png[/img]
[h3][i][b]Party Hard 2: Breakout[/b][/i] is now available on Steam for free![/h3]
Find out what happened after the events of [b][i]Party Hard 2[/i][/b] and the [i][b]Alien Butt Form[/b][/i] DLC in this hard-hitting, prison-breaking [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1192600/Party_Hard_2_Comic_Book_DLC/]30-page colored comic book[/url]!
[list]
[*]:PartyEye: Starring Party Hard Killer's bad*ss girlfriend, Marena, weird green dude Frogger, taxicab driver, and his mad dog Mango—characters from the [i]Alien Butt Form[/i] DLC, as well as some familiar faces from the original [i]Party Hard[/i]
[*]:partymask: The most notorious party crasher of the XXI century, the Party Hard Killer himself, is back!:partyknife:
[/list]
[i][b]Party Hard 2: Breakout[/b][/i] is a stand-alone interactive program. Download and enjoy!

:cleanfloppy:[u][b]NOTE:[/b][/u] This comic book is available [u]to all Party Hard 2 owners as a free DLC[/u]. To launch [i]Breakout[/i], please, update [i][b]Party Hard 2[/b][/i] and then go the game folder:

[i]DISC:\\Steam\\steamapps\\common\\Party Hard 2\\ComicBook[/i]

[b]You can also download the [url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/l5y3fwj80ebgtgk/Party%20Hard%202%20Breakout%20comic%20book.pdf?dl=0].pdf version[/url].[/b]

notes.title: Twitch Integration for main campaign, DLC chars pre-load, bug fixes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/f9d1e51c8df2a3c09e07bd0dd1f594a886055b00.gif[/img]
[h1][b]What is up, partygoers![/b][/h1]

[b]We are proud to present this massive update to you all. Buckle up—a lot of stuff is coming your way:[/b]
[list]
[*] Main campaign can now be played in [b]Twitch Integration mode[/b]. A special NPC is spawned to either help or mess with the player. NPC's behavior is determined by viewers' voting, as well as items drops for the player. Only main campaign levels available in this mode.
[*] Brand new [i]Alien Butt Form[/i] DLC characters are pre-loaded to your game. [b]Froger[/b], [b]Mango the Dog[/b] and [b]Marena[/b] will become available once you purchase the DLC, and there will be no need to download the content.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/7f3ac78ef4c961c255ed6f0530c478649cff4e8d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/5503397fdd35f97daabe250bdc30f0d7a3c912c9.png[/img][/url]
[*] Fixed [b]ПОБЕДА[/b] achievement
[*] Fixed [i]SET UP PARTYING COP[/i] objective on [u]Amusement Park[/u] level
[*] Fixed [spoiler][i]KILL ALIENS[/i][/spoiler] hidden objective on [u]VIP Club[/u] level ([spoiler]unlocking [b]The mask told me to[/b] achievement shouldn't be a problem from now on[/spoiler])
[*] Fixed NPCs seeing the player through obstacles
[*] Fixed instant arrest on [u]Factory[/u] level
[*] Fixed main menu navigation (character selection issues, etc.)
[*] Increased game performance 
[*] Minor bug fixes and improvements
[/list]
[i]Alien Butt Form[/i] DLC and [b]Level Editor[/b] will be available on March 19.

notes.title: Announcing Alien Butt Form DLC!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/4b33c3c1d6414d00e8bbb16ca1a289a0792f3344.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Good tidings, partygoers![/b][/h1]

We are mightily excited to announce (as you have [spoiler]or haven't[/spoiler] already guessed from the title) the first [i]Party Hard 2[/i] DLC: [b]Alien Butt Form[/b]! Little teaser below features brand new playable hero by the name of Froger Delirium and new OST piece:
https://youtu.be/qkxjOp8Zgd8
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
You have already said "Hi" to [b]Froger[/b], who will be one of 3 new playable DLC characters (all 3 also to be available for the main campaign.) Delirium is a man of few words and can beat likes (yes, likes. Why do you ask?) out of people.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/059e990846571dca54ed8b1a60961f2dbff0b98a.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/029677a97d0f1bce8e5615777e90eb374d3f785b.gif[/img]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Ever wanted to play as an animal in [i]PH2[/i]? [b]Mango[/b] is off the wall Jack Russell Terrier who... electrocutes partygoers with his urine? I mean...
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/0a1435e25dc13955821dd32d56828980bf27aa53.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/d68adeb657facc1d06627f7edd95eadc323936e1.gif[/img]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
You already know this girl, right? About time to step into [b]Marena[/b]'s shoes. Be careful, though.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/63d6f44e8b5dea6dd8b009f6fec43b74091a087d.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/173b1d636708c6d5599d17489ffc6d79c53fd88c.gif[/img]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Also, [b]Alien Butt Form[/b] DLC will feature 5 new big-butt maps and plenty of fresh items & weapons to play with. Price and release date will be announced later. Follow [i]Party Hard 2[/i] for the latest news!

notes.title: Working Hard Devblog: Playable character teaser, story finished
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/fbb576bc8fca42b9e4a33e3e0e04ef3da5ee0842.png[/img]

[h1][b]What's up, community![/b][/h1]

[b]Welcome back to [i]Working Hard[/i] devblog. Sorry for keeping an eerie silence for a while: it have been quite a busy and pretty vacationless summer for us so far. But we're back with the most important news we have to share with you.[/b]
----
:AnimalDJ: We have finished composing and writing the story. Dialogues are now being voiced-over by professional actors as we localize them and polish the cutscenes. In [i]Party Hard 2[/i]'s story, the masked knife-wielding protagonist seeks revenge (we hope ke knows what for) against a vicious corporation he used to work for. In the process, a shocking truth is revealed to him. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/b80982c63959e3b9d4395ff12743a6639c79ec76.gif[/img]
----
:partymask: We are excited to reveal that the sequel will have multiple playable characters just like the original [i]Party Hard[/i]. In addition to the main character–[u]Party Hard Killer[/u]–we have designed 3 other unique heroes for you to ruin parties as. Fans who loved sneaking about in the role of [i]Ninja[/i] in the first game will have a surprise coming their way: a brand new stealth-based character, an extraterrestrial phenomenon [b]Kao Tech[/b]:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/b96ae94fb7503dd96d83928739405034a1f8c911.gif[/img]
----
:partydisk: Aside from creating tons of content, we are also working hard on optimizing the game for it to run nice and easy on less powerful machines. Talk about getting ahead of performance complaints. 
------
Ok, guys, that about sums it up for now. If you have any suggestions or questions, feel free to contact us at all times. And now, let the development process continue!

[b]Throw [u]Party Hard 2[/u] into your wishlists and follow it for the latest news:[/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/572430/Party_Hard_2/
Also, follow [url=https://twitter.com/PinoklGames]us[/url] and our game on [url=https://twitter.com/partyhardgame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/partyhardgames/]Facebook.[/url]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/269c5b193adc075511c27b77e7f6128bee624f13.png[/img]

notes.title: Working Hard Devblog: Introducing... bottles!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/e7cc98305cd3559aab28275ee034c0b8b4d87ac8.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hello, partygoers![/b][/h1]

[b]Welcome back to [i]Working Hard[/i]! In the first edition of our brand new [i]Party Hard 2[/i] devblog we told you a little bit about the Motel level and its aspects. This time the spotlight goes to sequel's newest feature: bottle tricks![/b]

:water:First and foremost, at any party bottles serve for one thang and one thang only: containing good ([i]not always[/i]) booze. Need to distract someone? A flask of a good one should help:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/5df3111050bbde93f65ecd7e400e5287b5cd7f5b.gif[/img]

:water:When we were little, we used to toss bottles at people for fun. Now we have grown up, and, with a slight shade of shame, wish to share this remarkable technique with you, guys. Thank you childhood for teaching us ways of classic stealth:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/931b39e89d918364e92a2d19efa6e56e175fdc3e.gif[/img]

:water:Our folks told us not to play with fire. But they bever mentioned playing with fire and booze:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/70cffc5f1c4f23a8f9ee19049d61c4f3b48fc282.gif[/img]

Well, enough disorderly conduct for today, goers. See you in the next [i]Working Hard[/i]! 

[b]Also, add [i]Party Hard 2[/i] to your [u] wishlists[/u] and [u] follow[/u] it for the latest news:[/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/572430/Party_Hard_2/

notes.title: Working Hard Devblog: Introducing Motel Level
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/fbb576bc8fca42b9e4a33e3e0e04ef3da5ee0842.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hello, community![/b][/h1]

[b]Welcome to [i]Working Hard[/i]: Party Hard 2 devblog! Here we will be telling you about features that we add to the game while it is under development. We start with the introduction of the [u]Motel[/u] level:[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/be5398aec08ced9035c88e10e9ed3da480cde3a0.gif[/img]

Motel will be the first stage in the story mode to feature vast outdoor areas. Prepare for tougher stealth challenge because you will have a lot of eyes on you:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/f2b2e2198c5ae413c4efc27dc117dcfd0adf78d7.png[/img]

Besides good ol' party stopping, you will be pushing pianos on unsuspecting passers-by, hide from (or confront) biker goons and play around with f(t)ire:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/8421802ece241026240c8c16263223176d704a81.gif[/img]

What do fires and vehicles have in common? We will allow you to drive a motorcycle to find out: 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28597375/896c775b302823ccefd11960b079928aba71ce9b.gif[/img]

Expect fun side objectives and a few secrets to unvail. See you in the next [i]Working Hard[/i], fawkes!

[b] Add [i] Party Hard 2[/i] to your [u] wishlists[/u] and [u] follow[/u] it for the latest news:[/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/572430/Party_Hard_2/
